lines.convergence: softening has converged at eps 0.0083 if the three-seed mean D(z = 0, 3-5) is under 0.5 percent (round five's same-phase noise floor). Converged on the interval if the upper t bound is also under 0.5. Not converged if the mean is 0.5 or more.
lines.if_not_converged: round seven's 0.976 (eps 0.0167 at 0.5 spacing) and round eight's 0.998 (eps 0.0083 at 0.25) are both softening-limited readings, not converged values; the 0.998 inference becomes a lower bound in softening and the converged-softening 1024^3 figure is about 0.998 x (1 + D) plus later halvings (geometric tail D r / (1 - r), r = D / 1.84, inferred).
lines.if_converged: the 0.998 inference stands in softening; the remaining open factors are mass resolution past 1024^3, box and the emulator's own error at k 3-5.

amendments.text: The budget rule as written stopped the round after the null: it scaled the whole remaining mandatory projection (2355 kJ) by the measured/projected ratio of the null alone (31.6 kJ against 25, ratio 1.27, a 95 s run on a card drawing about 225 W for other jobs), giving 3020 kJ against the 3000 cap, so every other run was skipped and nothing else ran. Null result: sha256 d7ec3cf1aa71... (pass); it is kept and not rerun. Amended rule: before each launch, measured + ratio x (this run's projection) + 25 kJ held for the branch null must stay under 3000 kJ; the ratio uses only runs projected at 100 kJ or more (1.0 until one exists). Queue order changes so that a budget cut drops pooled seeds rather than the convergence test: M_lo x5, S_half x3, planted, M_hi seeds 9 to 13, then S_pure. Queue: r9/queue2.sh; the first rule and log are kept as budget_v1.py and queue_v1.log. No prediction, line or run configuration changes.
